messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: How can I change the background color of the shinydashboard sidebar?
parts:
You can use some custom CSS. If you're using the blue skin (which is the default) you can do something like this:

library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)

ui <- dashboardPage(
  dashboardHeader(),
  dashboardSidebar(
    sidebarMenu(
      menuItem("A"),
      menuItem("B")
    )
  ),
  dashboardBody(
    tags$head(tags$style(HTML('
      .skin-blue .main-sidebar {
        background-color: #666666;
      }
      .skin-blue .sidebar-menu>li.active>a, .skin-blue .sidebar-menu>li:hover>a {
        background-color: #444444;
      }
    ')))
  )
)

server <- function(input, output) {}

shinyApp(ui, server)


-Winston
